name: Bali
tagline: Tropical leadership retreats, wellness & oceanfront summits
intro: World-class convention centres in Nusa Dua paired with tranquil cliffside villas and immersive cultural offsite experiences.
access: Flights from Delhi, usually with one stop.
highlights: Resort campuses designed for groups, where a conference, a team activity and a themed dinner all happen on one property.
Very strong perceived reward value, which is the entire point of an incentive trip.
Villa and resort mix suits a leadership retreat and a large sales conference equally.
planning_note: Travel time and a stop at each end mean a sub-four-night programme spends too much of itself in transit. Plan five nights or choose somewhere closer.
